This [[Chest of the Slaver (Justiciar Thommis)]] will spawn after defeating [[Justiciar Thommis]] in the [[Slavers' Exile]] dungeon. Each player in the party can open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in [[normal mode]] and two in [[hard mode]]. 

==Locations==
[[Depths of Tyria]]
*[[Slavers' Exile]]
**[[Justiciar Thommis]]'s Level

==Drops==
===[[Rare crafting material]]s===
*[[Diamond]]
*[[Onyx Gemstone]]

=== Others ===
These hard-to-find [[Item rarity|gold]] items can also drop from this chest:

* [[Amethyst Aegis]]
* [[Draconic Aegis]]
* [[Gloom Shield]]
* [[Pyroclastic Axe]]
* [[Saurian Scythe]]
* [[Silver Boar Scepter]]
* [[Storm Bow]]
* [[Voltaic Spear]]

==Notes==
*Unlike other [[Dungeon Chest]]s, no countdown-timer will appear once every [[Party|Party Member]] has opened the Chest. This allows players to exit the current level back to the Slavers' Exile staging area.
